purpose: Proves the ready-for-verification gate passes when the working tree is clean (no uncommitted/dirty entrypoint edits in flight), the artifact was shown to the user, required files exist, and rendered evidence (a real screenshot) is present.
required_evidence: working tree clean: no pending/elided/uncommitted entrypoint mutation
rendered evidence: verify_web_app screenshot artifact present and non-empty
rationale: The standard-level static.site finalizer requires a clean tree, present required files, a user-visible artifact, and rendered proof it loads. All conditions hold and the finalizer name matches the pinned regex, so the gate oracle returns pass.
